description: Production against a self-hosted OpenAI-compatible endpoint, reached by repointing a live model profile with BASETEN_BASE_URL: the endpoint's host must not be a Baseten host, the store is Postgres via DATABASE_URL, and the endpoint's key must be present in the environment. Naming this profile binds these rules — a configuration that violates one refuses at startup, by name, before anything serves.
label: Hosted, self-served endpoint — the production shape off Baseten's hosts
name: hosted-self
